statement: Dolphin dispatches Wii speaker-enable output report 0x14 and speaker-mute 0x19 as one-byte control payloads with separate bit-2 enable flags, and speaker-data report 0x18 as a packed length of at most twenty encoded bytes plus a fixed data area and independent rumble flag. Its emulated controller conditionally acknowledges 0x14/0x19, ignores oversized speaker payloads, and routes accepted 0x18 bytes into the speaker I2C slave at data offset 0. Dolphin documents unresolved exceptions where data reports may receive errors under rapid sending. Register setup arrives as ordinary memory writes through output 0x16, not a distinct audio report; real passthrough relays these writes without interpreting speaker registers.

applicability.scope: EmuSubroutines.cpp 90-125, 362-399; WiimoteReport.h 68-78, 149-159; WiimoteReal.cpp 260-291. Report roles align with wii-gap-wiibrew-speaker-control-reports, although exact hardware ACK/overrun behavior remains unverified.
